Hi Sam — confirmed for Wed May 21, 11:00–11:30 AM PDT. Calendar invite attached.

Answers to your quick questions:
- Sandbox keys: yes — the environment supports ~2K-token requests and 512-dim embeddings for this lab. The key we'll provide is short-lived (24h) and scoped to the sandbox project.
- Payload and limits: sandbox enforces the same per-request token limits as Hosted API prod for the selected model; we'll use the rdx-2.1-embedding and rdx-lm-13b variants for the session.
- KV cache: the sandbox simulates KV cache behavior for repeated-turn performance measurements, but absolute latency may be ~10–15% higher than a fully warmed dedicated pool. We'll surface cache hit rates in the session.

Attachments: redwood-quick-lab-invite.ics (calendar invite), sandbox-credentials-stub.txt (placeholder; actual key will be sent in a separate short-lived email 1 hour before the session).

Marissa — tagging you so engineering can standby briefly to help with any model selection/quantization questions during the lab. If you aren’t available, Diego can escalate to the on-call eng lead.

See you Wednesday — we'll include a 5-minute buffer at the start for provisioning.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
SDR Lead, Redwood Inference
